title: rosa canina var. fallax
intro: Rosa canina var. fallax, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose, is a variety of the dog rose shrub. It is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe, characterized by its small, fragrant flowers and dark green leaves. The dwarf dog rose is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. fallax include demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids.
